tools.name: browser_launch
tools.description: Launch Camoufox stealth browser and navigate to URL. Browser persists between calls. By default cookies/localStorage persist in ~/.camoufox-mcp/profile. Set fresh_profile=true to start with a clean temp profile (auto-cleaned on browser_close) — useful when switching between accounts on the same domain.

width.description: WINDOW width (0 = default 1280). The viewport matches this width and is 80px shorter than the window height (browser chrome) — use set_viewport_size to set a viewport independently of the window.

no_viewport.description: Let the content area follow the real OS window instead of a fixed viewport (Playwright viewport:null). WARNING: this drops the window-size cap, so the viewport can end up LARGER than the spoofed screen — a window wider than its own screen is an easy anti-bot tell. Prefer set_viewport_size unless you need a full-window canvas.

fresh_profile.description: Start with a clean temp profile (no carry-over cookies/cache). Temp dir is removed when browser_close is called. Use when switching between accounts on the same domain to avoid login session collisions.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser. Cookies are preserved in the persistent profile (~/.camoufox-mcp/profile). If the launch used fresh_profile=true, the temp profile is removed.

tools.name: reset_profile
tools.description: Delete the persistent profile (~/.camoufox-mcp/profile) entirely. Use to start fresh — cookies, localStorage, history all wiped. Browser must be closed first (call browser_close before this).

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Navigate back in history.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in history.

tools.name: reload
tools.description: Reload the current page.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Get visible interactive elements with ref IDs. Use refs with click/fill. Always call after navigation. On large pages (Outlook, dashboards) the response can be truncated — narrow with roles=["button","textbox"] or paginate with offset/limit. Refs stay stable regardless of filters (every visible element is still numbered).

roles.description: Only show elements matching these tags/roles/types, e.g. ["button","link","textbox","tab"]. Empty = all.

offset.description: Skip the first N matched elements (pagination).

limit.description: Max elements to return (0 = no cap).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the page, or a single element with ref/selector (great for documenting one modal). Returns the IMAGE inline — no second Read call — plus the saved path. Set return_image=false for path only.

full_page.description: Full scrollable page (ignored when ref/selector is set)

ref.description: Snapshot ref — capture just that element.

selector.description: CSS selector — capture just that element (ignored if ref is set).

return_image.description: Embed the PNG in the response. false = only save to disk.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click element by ref ID from browser_snapshot. Auto JS-fallback for overlays.

tools.name: click_text
tools.description: Click element by visible text. If the text matches several elements it FAILS with a numbered candidate list instead of silently clicking the first one — narrow with within ("@dialog", a CSS selector, or "ref:e5") or pick one with index.

within.description: Limit the search: "@dialog" = topmost modal, "ref:e5" = inside a snapshot ref, or any CSS selector.

index.description: Which match to click when several match (0-based). -1 = require a unique match.

tools.name: click_role
tools.description: Click element by ARIA role and name. Same ambiguity guard as click_text: several matches → candidate list, not a guess.

within.description: Limit the search: "@dialog", "ref:e5", or a CSS selector.

index.description: Which match to click when several match (0-based). -1 = require a unique match.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover over element by ref ID.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Fill input/textarea by ref ID. Always replaces existing content (email/number inputs are cleared explicitly first — Firefox's select-all is a no-op on those, which would otherwise append).

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Select option from <select> dropdown.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Check checkbox or radio button.

tools.name: uncheck
tools.description: Uncheck a checkbox.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text char by char via keyboard.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press key or combo (Enter, Escape, Control+a, etc.).

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait for element/text to appear or disappear.

tools.name: wait_for_navigation
tools.description: Wait for page load to complete.

tools.name: wait_for_any_of
tools.description: Race multiple wait conditions — returns the first that matches, so the agent can branch immediately without sequential probes. Each condition is {kind: 'selector'|'text'|'url_contains'|'title_contains', value: string}. Returns the index + kind + value of the winning condition (or 'timeout' if none matched). Ideal for post-login flows where the next page could be any of several (e.g. 'Stay signed in?', 'Skip for now', or the inbox directly).

conditions.description: Conditions to race. First match wins.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in page context.

tools.name: get_url
tools.description: Get current URL and title.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Get visible text from page or element.

tools.name: get_html
tools.description: Get HTML content from page or element.

tools.name: tab_list
tools.description: List all open tabs.

tools.name: tab_new
tools.description: Open new tab.

tools.name: tab_select
tools.description: Switch to a tab by index, or by url_contains (first tab whose URL contains the substring).

index.description: Tab index. Ignored if url_contains is set.

url_contains.description: Select the first tab whose URL contains this substring.

tools.name: tab_close
tools.description: Close a tab by index (-1 = active), or by url_contains.

url_contains.description: Close the first tab whose URL contains this substring (overrides index).

tools.name: cookie_list
tools.description: List cookies.

tools.name: cookie_set
tools.description: Set a cookie. IMPORTANT: with expires_days=0 this creates a SESSION cookie, which Firefox keeps in memory only — it is gone after browser_close even though the profile itself persists. Pass expires_days (e.g. 30) to write a login session that survives a relaunch.

expires_days.description: Lifetime in days. 0 = session cookie (dies with the browser).

http_only.description: Set the HttpOnly flag (hides it from page JS, like a real auth cookie).

secure.description: Set the Secure flag (HTTPS only). Required when same_site='None'.

tools.name: cookie_delete
tools.description: Delete cookies. Both empty = clear all.

tools.name: dialog_handle
tools.description: Set handler for the next alert/confirm/prompt on ANY open tab (first dialog wins, handler then clears).

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload file to file input.

tools.name: chatgpt_generate_image
tools.description: Generate or edit an image on chatgpt.com end-to-end and save it to disk in ONE call. Opens a fresh chat, optionally uploads reference images (e.g. a brand logo), submits the prompt, waits for the generated image to finish, then writes the result PNG to output_path. Requires an authenticated chatgpt.com session (import cookies first via cookie_import). Returns the saved path and pixel dimensions. Note: chatgpt image generation is slow (~60-120s) — set timeout_ms accordingly.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the resulting PNG.

image_paths.description: Optional reference image file paths to upload before prompting (e.g. a logo).

timeout_ms.description: Max ms to wait for the generated image.

tools.name: chatgpt_generate_batch
tools.description: Generate MANY images on chatgpt.com IN PARALLEL (one tab per job, fire-all-then-collect) and save each to disk. Submits every job first WITHOUT waiting, then waits for all generations concurrently — far faster than sequential. For a CONSISTENT feed set, pass shared_image_paths (e.g. [logo] and/or a style-reference image like a previously-generated hero) uploaded to EVERY tab, plus style_suffix (a shared style spec) appended to every prompt. Requires an authenticated chatgpt.com session (import cookies first). Returns per-job results (saved path / ok / bytes / error).

jobs.description: Per-image jobs: each has a prompt and an output PNG path.

shared_image_paths.description: Reference images uploaded to EVERY tab (e.g. [logoPath, styleRefPath]) — key for visual consistency.

style_suffix.description: Shared style spec text appended to every prompt (exact colors, typography, layout, mood) for consistency.

timeout_ms.description: Max ms to wait for each image to finish.

stagger_ms.description: Delay between submitting each tab (avoids UI/anti-bot races).

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page.

tools.name: console_start
tools.description: Start capturing console messages from all tabs.

tools.name: console_get
tools.description: Get captured console messages.

tools.name: network_start
tools.description: Start capturing network requests. With capture_bodies=true also records request/response headers + text bodies (json/text/xml/form only, capped at body_limit bytes) so you can inspect API payloads via network_get_detail — no need to pivot to evaluate()+fetch().

capture_bodies.description: Also capture request/response headers and text bodies.

body_limit.description: Max bytes kept per request/response body.

tools.name: network_get
tools.description: List captured network requests in capture order, keeping the most recent `limit` rows. Each row shows an #id usable with network_get_detail.

filter.description: Only show requests whose URL contains this substring.

tools.name: network_get_detail
tools.description: Full request + response detail (headers and text body) for one captured request. Requires network_start(capture_bodies=true) BEFORE the request fired. Identify the request by id (from network_get) or by url substring.

id.description: Request #id from network_get. -1 = match by url instead.

url.description: When id=-1, match the newest request whose URL contains this substring.

tools.name: save_pdf
tools.description: Save page as PDF. NOTE: Playwright can only generate PDFs in headless Chromium — Camoufox is Firefox, so this fails by design here. Use screenshot(full_page=true) instead. Kept for API compatibility.

tools.name: batch_actions
tools.description: Execute multiple actions in one call. Each action: {type, ref?, value?, text?, key?, url?}.

actions.description: List of actions to execute sequentially

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields and optionally submit.

submit_ref.description: Ref of submit button to click after filling

tools.name: login_classic
tools.description: Composite login for classic email→password forms (Google, Microsoft, generic SSO). Auto-detects the email field, clicks Next/Continue on multi-step forms, fills the password, submits, and optionally enters a TOTP 2FA code. Collapses the usual 5–8 fill/click/snapshot calls into one. Heuristic — if a form is unusual, fall back to individual fill/click tools. Returns the step log + a fresh snapshot.

totp_secret.description: Base32 TOTP secret — a 6-digit code is generated if a 2FA field appears.

submit_after_email.description: Click Next/Continue after the email (Google/Microsoft multi-step).

step_timeout_ms.description: Max wait for each step's field to appear.

tools.name: navigate_and_snapshot
tools.description: Navigate to URL then return snapshot — combined in one call.

tools.name: intercept_start
tools.description: Block requests before they leave the browser. Blocking image/media/font/stylesheet typically removes most of a page's bytes — the single biggest speed-up for scraping — and block_urls kills trackers and ad frames. Routed on the context, so tabs opened later are covered too. Re-calling replaces the previous rules; intercept_stop removes them. 'document' cannot be blocked: it would abort the navigation itself.

block_urls.description: URL patterns to abort — plain substring, or use * as a wildcard (e.g. *doubleclick.net*).

log_limit.description: How many decisions to keep for intercept_log.

tools.name: intercept_stop
tools.description: Remove interception rules and report what they blocked.

tools.name: intercept_log
tools.description: Show what interception blocked and allowed.

tools.name: export_curl
tools.description: Rebuild a captured request as a runnable curl command, so you can replay or share an API call without re-deriving its headers. Needs network_start(capture_bodies=true) — headers are not recorded otherwise.

url_contains.description: Pick the most recent captured request whose URL contains this.

id.description: Or pick by the id shown in network_get.

tools.name: inspect_element
tools.description: Get detailed info about an element (tag, attributes, bounding box, styles).

tools.name: get_attribute
tools.description: Get a specific attribute value from an element.

tools.name: query_selector_all
tools.description: Query elements by CSS selector, return text/attributes of all matches.

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Get all links on the page with URL and text.

filter.description: Filter links by URL pattern (empty = all)

tools.name: localstorage_get
tools.description: Get all localStorage data or a specific key.

tools.name: localstorage_set
tools.description: Set a localStorage item.

tools.name: localstorage_clear
tools.description: Clear all localStorage.

tools.name: sessionstorage_get
tools.description: Get all sessionStorage data or a specific key.

tools.name: sessionstorage_set
tools.description: Set a sessionStorage item.

tools.name: mouse_click_xy
tools.description: Click at exact x,y coordinates. steps>0 adds interpolated pre-movement (human-like).

tools.name: mouse_move
tools.description: Move mouse to x,y. steps>0 interpolates path (human-like).

tools.name: click_turnstile
tools.description: Auto-solve Cloudflare Interactive Turnstile checkbox. Locates the widget via in-page selectors AND the Playwright frame API (handles closed shadow roots that document.querySelector misses), polls for render, skips if already solved, then does a humanized real-mouse click with retries + small nudge, verifying the cf-turnstile-response token after each attempt. Managed Challenge full-page interstitials still need mcp-stealth-chrome.

offset_x.description: Pixels from widget left edge to the checkbox (calibrated for CF checkbox)

offset_y.description: Vertical offset from widget top (default = height/2)

wait_render_ms.description: Wait before first detection to let widget render

max_attempts.description: Max click attempts (small vertical nudge between tries) until token appears

tools.name: drag_and_drop
tools.description: Drag from one element to another.

tools.name: list_frames
tools.description: List all frames/iframes in the page.

tools.name: frame_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript inside a specific frame/iframe.

tools.name: wait_for_url
tools.description: Wait for URL to match a pattern.

tools.name: wait_for_response
tools.description: Wait for a network response matching a URL pattern.

tools.name: get_viewport_size
tools.description: Get current viewport dimensions.

tools.name: set_viewport_size
tools.description: Set the viewport width and height. This is the exact control over what the page renders and what a screenshot captures. It does NOT resize the OS window: Camoufox reports a frozen outerWidth/outerHeight, so asking for a viewport larger than the launch window makes the content bigger than its own window — impossible geometry that a detector can read. The reply says so when that happens.

tools.name: accessibility_snapshot
tools.description: Get accessibility tree snapshot — compact view of page structure for LLM understanding.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Health check — verify server, browser status, active tabs.

tools.name: get_page_errors
tools.description: Get uncaught JavaScript errors + unhandled promise rejections from the current page. Captured by a hook installed at browser_launch, so the buffer resets on every navigation (read it before navigating away). Max 100 entries per page load.

tools.name: inject_init_script
tools.description: Inject a script that runs before every page load.

tools.name: export_har
tools.description: Export captured network traffic as a HAR 1.2 file (openable in DevTools/other HAR viewers). Requires network_start first; headers and bodies are only included when network_start(capture_bodies=true) was used.

tools.name: fingerprint_audit
tools.description: Report the fingerprint a site actually sees from this browser, and flag internal contradictions — the mismatches that get an automated browser detected are far more revealing than any single value. Read-only: it inspects, it does not change anything.

tools.name: detect_content_pattern
tools.description: Auto-detect repeated content patterns (cards, listings, rows) and suggest CSS selectors. Run this BEFORE extract_structured to find the right selectors.

min_items.description: Minimum repeated items to detect as pattern

tools.name: extract_structured
tools.description: Extract structured data from repeated elements (cards, rows, listings). Auto-deduplicates, filters empty items, extracts direct text only. Use detect_content_pattern first to find correct selectors.

container_selector.description: CSS selector for each repeated item. Use detect_content_pattern to find this.

attribute.description: Attribute to extract (empty = direct text only)

fields.description: Fields to extract from each item

deduplicate_by.description: Field name to deduplicate by (empty = auto)

direct_text_only.description: Extract only direct text of matched element, not children text (prevents field mixing)

tools.name: extract_table
tools.description: Extract data from an HTML table as JSON array.

tools.name: scrape_page
tools.description: Smart page scraper — auto-detect and extract main content, links, metadata. Strips nav/footer noise.

max_text_length.description: Max text chars (truncates at paragraph boundary)

only_main_content.description: Strip nav, header, footer, sidebar — extract only main content area

tools.name: wait_and_snapshot
tools.description: Wait for selector/text then return snapshot. Combines wait_for + browser_snapshot in one call.

tools.name: back_and_snapshot
tools.description: Navigate back + return snapshot.

tools.name: reload_and_snapshot
tools.description: Reload page + return snapshot.

tools.name: click_and_snapshot
tools.description: Click element by ref + wait + return snapshot. Perfect for buttons that trigger navigation/dialog.

tools.name: find_by_text
tools.description: Find elements by visible text — returns EVERY match (total + a ref and ancestor path per candidate), so you can tell whether the one you want is really the one you'd click. Skip browser_snapshot when you know the text.

within.description: Limit the search: "@dialog", "ref:e5", or a CSS selector.

tools.name: find_by_label
tools.description: Find input element by its label text (<label>). Returns ref + how many matched.

within.description: Limit the search: "@dialog", "ref:e5", or a CSS selector.

tools.name: find_by_placeholder
tools.description: Find input by placeholder text. Returns ref + how many matched.

within.description: Limit the search: "@dialog", "ref:e5", or a CSS selector.

tools.name: cookie_export
tools.description: Export all cookies as JSON string. Use with cookie_import to transfer session.

tools.name: cookie_import
tools.description: Import cookies from JSON (from cookie_export). Restores session state.

tools.name: page_stats
tools.description: Page statistics: element count, size, load metrics. Use to decide extraction strategy.

tools.name: storage_state_save
tools.description: Save cookies + localStorage to a JSON file. Reload via storage_state_load on a fresh browser to skip login/CF entirely.

tools.name: storage_state_load
tools.description: Load cookies + localStorage from a JSON file (created by storage_state_save). Bypass CF/login if session is fresh.

path.description: Path to storage state JSON file

navigate_to.description: URL to navigate to after loading (recommended — localStorage requires same-origin)

tools.name: auth_capture
tools.description: Save current session as named auth state (e.g. logged-in user). Convenience wrapper: storage_state_save to ~/.camoufox-mcp/sessions/<name>.json

tools.name: cookie_export_file
tools.description: Export all cookies to a JSON file (Playwright format).

tools.name: cookie_import_file
tools.description: Import cookies from a JSON file (Playwright format).

tools.name: humanize_click
tools.description: Click element with humanized mouse approach (3-step Bezier-like curve before click). Use for anti-bot pages.

tools.name: humanize_type
tools.description: Type text with Gaussian-distributed delays between keystrokes (mean ~80ms, sigma ~30ms). Mimics human typing rhythm.

tools.name: mouse_drift
tools.description: Random mouse movements over a duration — builds up mouse history before action (CF/DataDome behavior analysis).

tools.name: mouse_record
tools.description: Start recording mouse positions in the page (replay with mouse_replay). Re-calling replaces any previous recorder instead of leaking its listener.

tools.name: mouse_replay
tools.description: Replay last recorded mouse path with original timing.

tools.name: session_warmup
tools.description: Visit innocuous public sites (Google, Wikipedia) to build browsing history before targeting protected site. Helps with CF/DataDome IP scoring.

tools.name: detect_anti_bot
tools.description: Heuristic detection of anti-bot vendor on current page (Cloudflare, DataDome, Akamai, PerimeterX, Imperva).

tools.name: assert_element_visible
tools.description: Assert element exists and is visible. Returns success/fail (no throw).

tools.name: assert_text_present
tools.description: Assert text is present anywhere on page (case-sensitive substring).

tools.name: assert_url_matches
tools.description: Assert current URL matches pattern (substring or regex).

tools.name: click_and_wait
tools.description: Click element then wait for navigation or selector. Atomic — fewer roundtrips than separate click + wait_for.

wait_for_url.description: URL substring to wait for after click

wait_for_selector.description: Selector to wait for after click

tools.name: wait_for_network_idle
tools.description: Wait until there are no in-flight requests for idle_ms continuously. Requests are counted from the moment the page was opened, so one that was ALREADY in flight when you call this is not mistaken for idle.

idle_ms.description: How long the network must stay quiet before returning.

tools.name: describe_page
tools.description: Compact LLM-friendly page summary (title, heading, key buttons, forms). Cheaper than browser_snapshot for agent context. Also returns `intent` — a classified hint of what kind of page this is (login_email, login_password, otp_input, captcha, stay_signed_in, protect_account, error_page, consent, two_factor, account_disabled, content, unknown) — so the agent can branch with one read.

tools.name: http_request
tools.description: HTTP request WITHOUT a browser, using a real Firefox TLS/HTTP2 fingerprint (impit). By default it reuses the live browser's cookies for that URL, so you can log in with the browser and then hit the site's API cheaply. Far faster and lighter than navigating — use it for APIs, JSON, and any page that doesn't need JS.

impersonate.description: TLS fingerprint to present. firefox matches the Camoufox browser.

tools.name: http_session_cookies
tools.description: Show which browser cookies would be sent with an HTTP request to this URL. Use it to confirm session sharing before relying on http_request.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web through a search API YOU control — a self-hosted SearXNG, or Brave/Tavily/Exa with a key — and get back a normalised title/url/snippet list. This never scrapes a SERP: that shipped in 0.9.0 and was removed in 0.9.2 because engines answer some queries with confidently wrong results. A real API contract does not have that failure mode. Set MCP_SEARCH_ENDPOINT (and MCP_SEARCH_API_KEY when the provider needs one) to avoid passing them every call.

endpoint.description: Search API base or full URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8899 for a self-hosted SearXNG. Defaults to $MCP_SEARCH_ENDPOINT.

provider.description: auto infers from the endpoint host and falls back to searxng.

api_key.description: Defaults to $MCP_SEARCH_API_KEY. A self-hosted SearXNG needs none.

extra_params.description: Extra query params as JSON, e.g. {"engines":"google,brave","language":"en"} (SearXNG).

tools.name: scrape_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return clean, LLM-ready markdown (headings, links, lists preserved; nav/footer/scripts stripped). Default path is browserless (impit) — fast and cheap. Set use_browser=true for JS-rendered pages (needs browser_launch).

use_browser.description: Render in the stealth browser instead of a plain HTTP fetch.

tools.name: smart_fetch
tools.description: Dual-mode fetch: tries the browserless HTTP path first and escalates to the stealth browser ONLY when the response looks anti-bot blocked. This is the efficiency core — high-volume reading stays cheap, the browser fires only when it's actually needed.

tools.name: search_page
tools.description: Grep the CURRENT page's visible text and return matches with surrounding context. Costs nothing compared to a snapshot or a screenshot — use it first to find where a term actually appears.

text.description: Substring, or a regex source when regex=true

tools.name: wait_for_change
tools.description: Wait until the page actually CHANGES and report what changed (url / title / DOM size / text). This is the honest version of a fixed sleep after a click: it returns as soon as something happened, or tells you nothing did.

settle_ms.description: Require the page to stay stable this long after the change.

tools.name: assert_clickable
tools.description: Hit-test an element WITHOUT clicking: would a real click actually land on it? Answers "why did my click do nothing?" before you spend the click. Reports the element that would intercept the click when something covers it.

tools.name: scroll_to
tools.description: Scroll a specific element into view (the page-level `scroll` tool only moves by pixels).

tools.name: click_element_offset
tools.description: Click at a percentage position inside an element instead of its centre — for wide labels whose real checkbox sits at the left edge, sliders, or split buttons.

tools.name: click_at_corner
tools.description: Click a corner of an element — close/X buttons, delete icons and dismiss controls usually live there, not in the centre.

offset.description: Inset in pixels from the corner.

tools.name: paste_text
tools.description: Fill a field with a REAL paste. Puts the text on the clipboard and presses Ctrl/Cmd+V so the page receives a trusted paste event with actual clipboardData — the only thing that works for frameworks that listen to paste alone (Svelte 5 / SolidJS runes, some Qwik forms). Falls back to a synthetic event and then the native value setter.

tools.name: form_introspect
tools.description: Analyse a form in one call: per field the label, type, current value, required/pattern/length constraints, validation state, and the JS framework it is bound to. Tells you what to fill and why a submit is being rejected without guessing from a snapshot.

form_selector.description: CSS selector for the form. Empty = first form, or all top-level fields if the page has none.

tools.name: smart_fill
tools.description: Fill form fields by their LABEL text (fuzzy, case-insensitive) instead of refs — no snapshot needed. Values go through the same clearing logic as fill, so email/number fields replace rather than append.

submit_label.description: If set, click the button whose text matches after filling.

tools.name: dialog_auto_handle
tools.description: Install a PERSISTENT dialog handler that stays armed across every dialog and every tab (dialog_handle is one-shot). Reads its action at fire time, so you can change it without re-arming. Set enabled=false to remove it.

prompt_text.description: Text to submit for prompt() dialogs.

tools.name: sessionstorage_clear
tools.description: Clear all sessionStorage for the current origin (parity with localstorage_clear).

tools.name: wait_for_request
tools.description: Block until the page ISSUES a request matching a URL substring (wait_for_response waits for the reply). Use it to confirm an action actually fired its API call.

tools.name: storage_snapshot
tools.description: Capture cookies + localStorage + sessionStorage + URL into a named slot, so storage_diff can tell you exactly what an action changed.

tools.name: storage_diff
tools.description: Compare current storage against an earlier storage_snapshot — shows exactly which cookies/localStorage/sessionStorage keys were added, removed or changed. The fastest way to find which key holds a session token.

tools.name: indexeddb_list
tools.description: List IndexedDB databases for the current origin. Many SPAs keep auth state and drafts here, invisible to cookie/localStorage tools.

tools.name: indexeddb_delete
tools.description: Delete an IndexedDB database by name for the current origin (clears SPA state that survives a cookie wipe).

tools.name: performance_timeline
tools.description: Navigation + paint + resource timing for the current page: TTFB, DOMContentLoaded, load, FCP, LCP, and the 5 slowest resources. Note: Firefox does not implement layout-shift, so CLS is unavailable here.

tools.name: browser_recover
tools.description: Escape hatch when the browser is wedged and browser_close can't complete: force-drops the connection and resets server state so browser_launch works again. Also reports a profile lock held by another Camoufox process, which is the usual cause of 'A copy of Camoufox is already open'.

tools.name: workflow_run
tools.description: Run a list of tool calls in sequence — any tool this server exposes, by name — and return a per-step log. Resumable: a failed run tells you the index, and start_at skips the steps that already succeeded. Each step is {"tool":"navigate","args":{"url":"…"},"label":"optional"}.

start_at.description: Skip the first N steps (resume after a failure).
